_comment: MOMENTUM ONLY. Answers 'how hot/cold is this player right now', signed -5..+5, centred at 0. Fully independent of Impact Rating (winImpactWeights.json) - no value here feeds Impact and vice versa. Tune freely without code changes.
_comment_streak: Hot-hand mechanic (Momentum only). Made FG steps up, missed FG/turnover steps down, clamped to [min,max], reset to `start` whenever the rolling window empties.
_comment_clutch: Same 1.6x / same conditions as Impact's clutch, but kept as its own block so the metrics never share constants.
_comment_eventImpacts: Base per-event values before streak and clutch multipliers. madeFt/missedFt are not in the core spec; small streak-neutral values so free throws still register.
